title: The Aeroplane, 5 Mar 1948, p.280: Delta 8, Hayden glider, Abrial project (Figs. 11-13)
description: Continuation page of the flying saucer article in The Aeroplane. It shows "Fig. 11.—Willoughby's 'Delta 8' experimental monoplane of 1938" in plan and side views, a photograph captioned "Fig. 12.—Experimental Hayden glider, 1925" with its dimensions, and "Fig. 13.—A French project of G. Abrial, 1929" in three views. Text discusses disc-wing aerodynamics and early experimenters.
